jmsa5pp5.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Bulbs Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
jmsa5pp5.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree embodies holiday warmth and elegance, designed to enhance your festive decor effortlessly. Its lush, green branches are painstakingly crafted from high-quality PVC and PE materials, ensuring a lifelike appearance that invites the magic of Christmas into your home. Ideal for living rooms, gardens, or terraces, this tree becomes a centerpiece of your holiday gatherings, offering a sleek and modern aesthetic with clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Materials: Constructed from premium PVC and PE, this artificial tree boasts realistic foliage with lifelike textures. The combination of PVC and polyethylene ensures durability and a natural aesthetic that endures over multiple seasons of use. Included Components: This tree includes flexible LED strip lights designed to provide warm, inviting illumination. They attach easily to the tree, enhancing its visual appeal without compromising the clean, modern look. Features /Function /Design: Featuring a hinged construction, this tree is engineered for ease and efficiency in setup and takedown. Its design supports optimal balance and style, perfect for modern festive decor. Recommended Uses: Designed for indoor and sheltered outdoor environments, the artificial tree brings holiday cheer to living rooms, garden terraces, and beyond, catering to those who desire an adaptable and stylish decor option. Care &Maintenance: Easy to maintain: dust gently and avoid harsh cleaning agents. Being primarily indoors, this tree's upkeep is simple, keeping your holiday centerpiece intact and ready for seasons to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and PE Stand size: 55 x 55 cm Hinged construction Lifelike PE tips Sturdy metal stand Number of PE tips: 301 Number of PVC tips: 590 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Power source: USB Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,40x3cmball,40x4cmball,40x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

xp31enrd.baseName: Ark Mat 80cm x 65cm Faux Fern Leaves Artificial Wreath - Amber Cascade
xp31enrd.variantName: Ark Mat 80cm x 65cm Faux Fern Leaves Artificial Wreath - Amber Cascade
xp31enrd.sourceDescription: Bring a fresh botanical feel to your home with this beautiful Artificial Greenery Wreath, designed with realistic-looking faux fern leaves and lush foliage. Perfect for adding colour, texture and natural-inspired style to your front door, porch, wall or indoor space. This artificial fern wreath is a versatile decoration that can be enjoyed all year round. Unlike real foliage, it requires no watering, trimming or specialist care, making it an easy way to keep your home looking fresh and inviting. Simply display it on your front door, wall, window or anywhere that needs a decorative touch of greenery. Ideal for both everyday home decoration and special occasions, this faux greenery wreath can be used to create a welcoming entrance for guests or complement your existing décor. It is suitable for front doors, porches, hallways, living rooms, conservatories, garden rooms, weddings, parties and celebrations. The timeless fern design makes this wreath easy to style with a wide range of interiors and exterior décor. Use it on its own for a simple natural look or pair it with ribbons, flowers, lights and other decorations to create your own personalised display. A stylish and practical alternative to fresh foliage, this artificial fern wreath is a simple way to bring the beauty of greenery into your home without the ongoing maintenance of real plants. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
